changes.evidence: After Ulysses' death Verussa holds the meeting of his monster hunting cabal at Bloodstone Manor and runs the hunt (Werewolf by Night). The wiki's Monster Hunting Cabal page lists her as a former leader (the cabal is led by the Bloodstone holder). New name, named plainly by the wiki and the special.

Zeus opens and presides over the Council of Godheads' meeting in the Golden Temple, Omnipotence City (Thor: Love and Thunder). The infobox lists Council of Godheads as his affiliation, and the Council page names him as leader. He is also King of the Olympians, if the owner prefers that name. New name, named plainly in the film/wiki.

Cassandra rules the Void with a militia of exiled mutant variants (Sabretooth, Toad, Juggernaut, Azazel, Pyro and others) that she assembled and commands, sending them against the Resistance and Deadpool/Wolverine (Deadpool & Wolverine). The wiki's 'Cassandra Nova's Henchmen' page (also called Cassandra Nova's Marauders / Cassandra's Militia) lists her as its leader, and her infobox affiliation is that group. New name, from the wiki.

In episode 5 President Loki commands an army of Loki variants in the Void (the wiki's 'Loki Bandits', of which he is 'President'), then his own followers turn on him in the same episode; the infobox lists Loki Bandits '(formerly)'. New name, from the wiki. If the owner prefers not to record a same-title departure, drop the Independent stage.

Surtur's title is Lord of Muspelheim and his citizenship is Muspelheim; he rules the realm and commands its Fire Demons when Thor fights him there (Thor: Ragnarok). Treated as a nation, like the existing 'Jotunheim'/'Asgard' groups. New name, named plainly in the film.

owner_calls.question: Klaue's S.H.I.E.L.D. file in Age of Ultron lists him as affiliated with a criminal organisation called Intelligencia. That is not the She-Hulk 'Intelligencia' already in group names (the wiki keeps a separate 'Intelligencia (Agency)' page with no other members, mentioned only). Should Klaue get this group?
options: No change (file mention only, not shown on screen)
Add ["Intelligencia (Agency)", "Avengers: Age of Ultron"] as a separate new group
Add ["Intelligencia", "Avengers: Age of Ultron"] (merged with the She-Hulk group)
owner_calls.evidence: Infobox: Intelligencia (Agency) '(formerly)', and the bio says that in his early criminal career he 'affiliated with a criminal agency known as Intelligencia'. Intelligencia (Agency) page: Klaue's membership 'was noted in a S.H.I.E.L.D. file' (AAoU). No departure is shown; he is listed as a former member only because he is dead.

owner_calls.question: Dormammu is the master the Zealots serve in Doctor Strange: he gives Kaecilius and the Zealots their power, and then absorbs them into the Dark Dimension. Does the deity a cult serves count as its leader?
owner_calls.evidence: Infobox affiliation: Zealots '(formerly)'; the Zealots are listed under him as 'Disciples'. Kaecilius leads the group on the ground, and Dormammu deceives and uses them (Doctor Strange).

owner_calls.question: Sinister Strange is still the Sorcerer Supreme / Master of his universe's Masters of the Mystic Arts in Multiverse of Madness, but his universe has been destroyed and he is the only survivor shown. Count him as a member?
options: Add ["Masters of the Mystic Arts", "Doctor Strange in the Multiverse of Madness"]
owner_calls.evidence: Infobox affiliation: Masters of the Mystic Arts (his variant universe's order), not marked 'formerly'; the bio says he trained as a Master of the Mystic Arts and became Sorcerer Supreme and Master of the New York Sanctum. In the film he lives alone in his ruined Sanctum.

owner_calls.question: Arishem is the Prime Celestial, and the wiki lists the Celestials as his subordinates and the Eternals as former subordinates. The Celestials are a species, not a named organisation. Should he get a group?
owner_calls.evidence: Title: 'The Judge / Prime Celestial'. Relationships: Celestials - Subordinates; Eternals and Deviants - Former Subordinates (he created them and gives them orders in Eternals). The infobox has no affiliation field.
